name: ASUS PRIME GeForce RTX 5080 OC Edition 16GB GDDR7 Graphics Card
shortDescription: ASUS PRIME GeForce RTX 5080 OC Edition 16GB GDDR7 Graphics Card (10752 CUDA Cores / 1801 AI TOPs / PCIe 5.0 / 256-bit Memory Bus / HDMI 2.1b / DisplayPort 2.1b / 2.5-Slot SFF Compatible / 1-Year Store Warranty)Experience
descriptionHtml:
ASUS PRIME GeForce RTX 5080 OC Edition 16GB GDDR7 Graphics Card (10752 CUDA Cores / 1801 AI TOPs / PCIe 5.0 / 256-bit Memory Bus / HDMI 2.1b / DisplayPort 2.1b / 2.5-Slot SFF Compatible / 1-Year Store Warranty)

Experience next-generation high-frame-rate 4K gaming and AI compute acceleration with the ASUS PRIME GeForce RTX 5080 OC Edition 16GB GDDR7 graphics card, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year store warranty. Featuring 10752 CUDA cores, ultra-fast 30 Gbps GDDR7 memory on a 256-bit bus, and an astounding 1801 AI TOPs performance, this GPU delivers unmatched visual fidelity powered by NVIDIA architecture. Built with a compact 2.5-slot SFF-ready footprint, native PCIe 5.0 support, and next-gen DisplayPort 2.1b display outputs, it offers sleek aesthetics alongside extreme cooling efficiency for modern enthusiast gaming setups.
